    StartersMobil Avenue platform sausage rollsPork, fennel and thyme sausage meat rolled in puff pastry with sesame, with tomato sauceHow to make it500g pork sausage mince1 small onion, grated1 tsp fennel seeds, crushed1 tsp dried thyme30g dried breadcrumbs1/4 tsp black pepper2 sheets of frozen puff pastry1 egg, beaten1 tbsp sesame seeds4 tbsp tomato sauce, to serveHeat the oven to 200°C, line a tray and thaw the pastry.Mix the sausage mince with the onion, fennel, thyme, breadcrumbs and pepper.Cut each pastry sheet in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal the seam.Brush with the egg, scatter with sesame, cut each roll into 6 and slash the tops.Chill on the tray for 15 minutes.Bake for 25 minutes until puffed, golden and cooked through.Serve hot with the tomato sauce.Club Hel devilled eggsHalved eggs piped with mustard yolk cream, dusted with smoked paprika, black sesame and chivesHow to make it6 eggs3 tbsp whole egg mayonnaise1 tsp dijon mustard1 tsp lemon juicecayenne pepper, a pinchsalt, to taste1/2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp black sesame seeds1 tbsp chives, finely choppedLower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes.Cool in iced water for 10 minutes.Peel, halve lengthways and scoop the yolks into a bowl.Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, cayenne and salt until smooth.Pipe or spoon the filling back into the whites.Dust with smoked paprika, black sesame and chives.MainsTrainman's dining car chicken and leek pieChicken thigh, leek and thyme in a creamy mustard sauce under golden puff pastryHow to make it800g chicken thigh fillets, cut into chunkssalt and pepper, to taste1 tbsp olive oil30g butter2 leeks, washed and sliced2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp plain flour400ml chicken stock150ml thickened cream1 tbsp dijon mustard1 tsp thyme leaves2 sheets of frozen puff pastry, thawed1 egg, beatenSeason the chicken and brown it in the oil in a wide pan in batches. Set aside.Melt the butter in the pan and soften the leeks and garlic for 8 minutes.Stir in the flour for a minute, then the stock, cream, mustard and thyme. Return the chicken and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.Cool the filling for 20 minutes.Heat the oven to 200°C. Spoon the filling into a pie dish, top with the pastry, crimp the edges, brush with egg and cut 2 vents.Bake for 30 minutes until puffed and deep golden.Rest for 5 minutes before serving.Rama-Kandra's family dalKarma is a word, like love.How to make it300g red lentils1 tsp ground turmeric1 brown onion3 garlic cloves20g ginger400g tinned crushed tomatoes150g baby spinach40g ghee2 tsp cumin seeds2 dried red chillies300g basmati rice4 naans1 lemon1 corianderSimmer the rinsed lentils with the turmeric and 1 litre of water for 20 minutes until soft, stirring now and then.Fry the chopped onion, garlic and ginger in half the ghee for 8 minutes, add the tomatoes and stir into the lentils with the spinach.Simmer the rice with 600ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, then rest for 5.Sizzle the cumin seeds and chillies in the rest of the ghee for 1 minute and pour over the dal.Warm the naan and serve with the dal, rice, lemon and coriander.SweetsTrainman's steamed golden syrup puddingLight steamed lemon sponge with a golden syrup top, turned out and served with vanilla custardHow to make it4 tbsp golden syrup125g butter, softened, plus extra for the basin125g caster sugar, for the pudding2 eggs175g self-raising flour1 lemon, zested3 tbsp milk, for the pudding400ml full cream milk, for the custard1 tsp vanilla extract4 egg yolks50g caster sugar, for the custard1 tbsp cornflourButter a 1.2 litre pudding basin and spoon the golden syrup into the base.Cream the butter and sugar until pale.Beat in the eggs one at a time, then fold in the flour, lemon zest and milk.Spoon into the basin, cover with pleated buttered baking paper and foil and tie with string.Stand on a trivet in a large pot with boiling water halfway up the basin, cover and steam for 90 minutes, topping up the water.For the custard, heat the milk and vanilla. Whisk the yolks, sugar and cornflour, pour on the hot milk, return to the pan and stir over low heat until thick.Rest the pudding for 5 minutes, turn out onto a plate and serve with the custard.DrinksSati's sunrise sodaOrange juice and soda over ice with grenadine sunk to the bottom like a sunriseHow to make it2 cups ice500ml orange juice, chilled400ml soda water, chilled80ml grenadine syrup1 lime, cut into wedges4 orange slicesFill 4 tall glasses with ice.Pour in the orange juice and top with the soda water.Slowly pour the grenadine down the inside of each glass so it sinks to the bottom.Squeeze in a lime wedge and finish with an orange slice.
